verification_method: Re-queried the actual installed interpreter/package versions in backend/.venv (the same venv every ml/ training and evaluation script in this repository's history has used) and compared field-by-field against the frozen manifest. No package was upgraded, downgraded, or reinstalled to force a match.

deterministic_settings.note: torch.set_num_threads(4) is called at the top of every training/evaluation script in ml/ - an infrastructure/performance setting (avoids CPU thread-oversubscription on this machine), not a scientific parameter. Does not affect numerical results, only wall-clock time.

note_on_mac_integration_environment: The Mac integration environment (Python 3.14, different PyTorch) referenced in the Day-9 canonical report is Emir/Claude's systems-integration environment, not the scientific training/evaluation environment. It has never been used to produce or reproduce any frozen ML result in this project. This verification concerns only the scientific stack (this Windows machine's backend/.venv), which is the actual environment every checkpoint in ml/checkpoints/ was trained and evaluated under.
